Mary (Hayley Mills) and her friend, Rachel (June Harding), are new students at St. Francis Academy, a boarding school run by the iron fist of Mother Superior (Rosalind Russell). The immature teens grow bored and begin playing pranks on both the unsuspecting nuns and their unpleasant classmates, becoming a constant thorn in Mother Superior's side. However, as the years pass, Mary and Rachel slowly mature and begin to see the nuns in a different light.

During the 1940s, Maurice Bendrix (Van Johnson), a writer recently discharged from the armed service, falls in love with Sarah Miles (Deborah Kerr), whom he interviews for a book. Sarah is married, but she and Maurice eventually give in to their mutual attraction, leading to an affair that lasts several months. Maurice's jealousy, along with the bombing of London by the Germans, seemingly lead to the end of their relationship. However, the reasons are later revealed to be more complex.

In this film adaptation of the classic Shakespeare play, Grumio and Hortensio both long to wed the same beautiful young woman. Unfortunately, her wealthy father will not let his daughter marry unless her hot-tempered sister, Katharina, also has a suitor. Luckily, the slovenly Petruchio is looking for an affluent woman to marry, so Grumio and Hortensio pay him to try to woo the extremely volatile Katharina.

Clumsy sanitation worker Red Jones (Red Skelton) is fired from his street-cleaning job shortly after his girlfriend, Ann Elliot (Janet Blair), refuses his marriage proposal until he betters himself. While training to become a door-to-door salesman, he accidentally stumbles into a murder investigation when the corrupt sanitation commissioner (Nicholas Joy) who had fired him is killed. When the murder weapon is found to be one of the brushes Red sells, he must fight to prove his innocence.

Resource Water rewards the designers with a “glamping” trip in the woods, filled with activities and relaxation. As the designers get to rejuvenate, bond, and sketch in nature, their challenge is to find inspiration from the outdoors for a high fashion look. The show ends with high emotion as Tim Gunn decides he disagrees with the judges and uses his only “Tim Gunn Save.”

In a challenge for Marie Claire, the designers are taken to the infamous Marie Claire shoe closet and given the challenge of designing an outfit inspired by a pair of shoes. But in order to get their shoes, they must compete against each other in a fashion trivia contest.

Heidi challenges the designers to create performance wear that is also fashionable for her New Balance collection. But first, the designers must participate in an obstacle course to see who gets an extra hour in the workroom and first dibs on fabric.

The designers are treated to a beautiful Southern brunch in the city. However, their relaxing is cut short as Tim arrives and explains that their challenge is to design a look for the Modern Southern woman—or, the Belk customer. After a challenging runway, the judges send the bottom three designers back to the drawing board, where they have one hour to rework their looks and save themselves from elimination. Ultimately two designers win the challenge, and one is out.

Through the help of L'Oreal Paris, the designers are given the opportunity to make over “Superfans” of Project Runway. Also, tensions run high as two designers engage in a heated conflict, and Tim has to intervene.

For the HP Challenge the designers must create a textile and look based on inspirations they receive from Next Generation Innovators. When the judges are not pleased on the Runway, two designers are eliminated.

For the L'Oreal Makeup Challenge, the designers are asked to create an avant-garde look inspired by butterflies. But there is a twist: They also have to redesign a previously loosing look from the season, as the judges prepare to decide who makes it to New York Fashion Week.

Fashion Week is just around the corner, and the remaining five designers return home to work on their collections. But even though two designers are guaranteed a spot at New York Fashion Week, the remaining three have to battle in front of the judges to prove who has what it takes to make it to the next level and show their collection at Lincoln Center.

When the Kleins Vizsla passed, they decided to search for another. Alas, Ruby was anything but the loyal, obedient water dog that the Vizslas are known to be. With young twins in the house, the Kleins will have to give Ruby up if these habits continue.

Anxiety comes in many forms. Josh, a lively Maltese who will not let anyone with a brush or pair of scissors near him. He would much rather chase the vacuum cleaner or run in circles around the house. Just try to keep him still and you might get bitten.

Brian and Patricia's border collie is overly protective of Patricia, nipping at anyone who comes near her. Officer James Espinoza rescued a German shepherd, Ali, named for famed boxer Muhammad Ali. Like his namesake, Ali is always ready for a fight.

Things could get wild as a dog and a goat meet at PawsAbility in their front-legged carts. Meanwhile, an elderly Labradoodle hopes to stay active in her golden years with a new knee brace, and a German Shepherd-Mastiff mix who is living the luxurious life needs an indoor slipper.

Big changes are in store for PawsAbility as Janice moves her practice north of Toronto. An old friend brings some new visitors for brace fittings, while a former Olympic Sledge Hockey champion and his miniature dachshund get some much needed cart adjustments.

Janice is being kept busy today with a rare case of a dog who uses prosthetics on both front legs. A schnoodle with a ton of allergies and a rescued greyhound also seek help for some recent injuries, while a cart-using Pyrenees mix proves to be one stubborn pup.

Things are getting tiny today as Janice attempts to create a prosthetic leg for a Chihuahua. A talkative black Lab who loves to chase squirrels and an Akita with an autoimmune disorder need specialized braces.

Dr. Kim shows up at the hospital with a bruised face, but he's out to save a burn victim first. The general manager of the casino comes to the hospital to take care of all the charges, but they're faced with a charge for putting a bruise on Dr. Kim's face. Meanwhile, Dong Joo and Seo Jung clear things out between themselves as Dong Joo wants to leave the hospital for good.

Bu Yong Ju is back. This worries the chairman and prompts for an emergency meeting at the Geosan University Medical Center. Dong Joo says that Gi Tae can shred his resignation letter if Dr. Kim turns out to be Dr. Bu Yong Ju, and he plans to continue working at Doldam Hospital. First, they've got to attend to a set of cyclists that get hit by a truck with a driver that had fallen asleep.

Seo Jung meets In Bum after years of not seeing each other. Dong Joo is worried about him and is quite displeased to have him at the hospital. That's after In Bum steps past his borders. Seo Jung recalls her past as a student who lost her mother and her memories spent with the president's family. Dr. Kim now talks about matters related to the foundation and the future of their hospital.

Details There's a standoff at the lobby of the Doldam Hospital. This time, it's In Bum and Hyeon Cheol versus Dr. Kim and the rest of the staff. The dispute isn't over after all the talks that had happened, and the future of Doldam seems to be entering murky waters of this devilish foggy forest of no hope. The micromanagement of President Do is getting in the way of Dr. Kim. For now, Seo Jung handles an 8 in a hundred chance of survival surgery.

After Dong Joo speaks up of the truth of the unjust treatment received by Doldam Hospital, the chairman makes an important phone call.

Unable to bring herself to shatter Euldam's vessel, Jeongi trembles before Gangcheon until Gwanghae arrives to intervene. Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.
A film capturing a journey across Korea, collecting the diverse sounds of everyday life and bringing them together to create a single piece of music.

Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

Detectives Barzak and Hazeltine are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department.

Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

The Hedgehogs congregate on the Floating Island in their latest effort to find their mother. But Sleet and Dingo also have an interest in this island.

Robotnik invents a Brain Evolution Achievement Negatizer, or B.E.A.N., in order to make all of Mobius stupid. But instead of turning Sonic and Tails into dummies, the BEAN device turns them into three year old babies!
Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness.

Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake.
Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his "brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer" to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver).
Momma escapes again from the Mobius Home for Really Bizarre People, disowns Robotnik for failing to capture Sonic, then with the help of an obscure Mobius law, adopts Sonic!

When S and G rocket to outerspace to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars.
When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck.

Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

Brandon Quark, an evil half-man, half-duck genius challenges, then teams up with Robotnik to capture Sonic. But Sonic knows their weakness, and pits the Badnik geniuses against one another, and sets himself free.

Sonic and the Freedom Fighters journey to Robotnik's lab in hopes of deciphering his roboti-sizer system. While underground, Sonic spots his now roboti-sized Uncle Chuck aboard a Badlands bound mine-train and devises a plan for his rescue.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.
On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

Dylan and Rev Bem help a peaceful society stand up to their would-be slavers. They have to be careful because if Dylan teaches them to kill, their kids will be born knowing it.
Dylan attempts to bring peace to two different Nietzschean prides by escorting the princess of one to her arranged marriage to the prince of the other.
Rommie's avatar falls in love with what turns out to be the avatar of a warship named Gabriel. Gabriel attempts to infect Rommie with a virus that broadcasts its plans to the warship.
Beka takes the Andromeda to Tarn-Vedra, but extended time in the slipstream causes side effects. To combat them, Beka starts taking Flash and soon becomes addicted.
An old memory from the Andromeda is accidentally activated, which sends her on a mission and leaves Dylan and the crew unable to override the command.
With the Andromeda damaged by their deadliest enemies, Dylan and Rommie must rescue Tyr, Harper, and Rev from a Magog World ship.
Dylan, Beka, Rev, and Tyr crash land after escaping a gang of Nietzscheans, but soon face a new threat: Rev's need to feed.
The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.
Andromeda answers a distress call when a cargo ship is attacked. Meanwhile, Trance is interrogated after paying a visit to the people.

programmes.st: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
programmes.d: The crew looks for a long-lost Commonwealth leader who has gone into hiding. They find her, but one question remains: is it actually her?

The crew is separated: Dylan, Beka, and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a new weapon being developed on a planet that is distrustful of AI; Harper, Tyr, and Rev struggle for survival when the Maru crashes into the ocean.
Andromeda is tasked with escorting medical ships safely through Drago-Kazov space.
A planet of Commonwealth survivors, led by Dylan's former fiance, is invited to join the new Commonwealth, but when they vote not to join, the Magog are suspected of playing dirty.
An agent of the Abyss tries to lure Harper into joining the Magog.
When they rescue a young prince from an uprising that kills the rest of his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisers.
Dylan and his new Commonwealth fleet take on the Drago-Kazov fleet but find it much larger than he expected.
The Magog eggs in Harper are starting to hatch, so the team builds a Tesseract Machine. After unintended time shifts, Trance is replaced by her future self.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Letter From the Past
programmes.d: Hostility grows between Jonathan and his adopted brother, Dio, as forgotten secrets emerge. Do the sinister slums of London hold the secret to the mask and Jonathan’s suspicions?
Jonathan and his new comrade, Speedwagon, confront Dio but are caught off guard when a savage reversal sends shock waves through the Joestar family.
Fate arranges the meeting of a broken Jonathan and the mysterious Zeppeli, master of Hamon energy. Meanwhile, one particularly savage vampire recruit hopes to slice his way to victory.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Dark Knights
programmes.d: Terror follows Jonathan and his fellow travelers to Windknight’s Lot, where they find themselves faced with the devious Dio. The onslaught of evil continues with two colossal knights.
Just as Jonathan’s heroism transforms one foe’s hatred into humanity, an even greater behemoth drives the crew to a knightly training camp, complete with a medieval chamber of death.

Conquering his own fear, an unlikely star opens an opportunity for Zeppeli and Jonathan. But as a prophecy from Zeppeli’s past unfolds dramatically in a clash of life, death, and succession, a true hero triumphs.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
programmes.d: With sword in hand and a team of Hamon masters at his side, Jonathan sets out to save Poco’s sister. When one slithery demon makes its move, Jonathan steps in, igniting an all-out war with his “brother.”

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Final Ripple!
programmes.d: Jonathan takes Erina’s hand in marriage before embarking on a celebratory journey to America. But two stowaways unwittingly change the course of history for all those onboard.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: New York's JoJo
programmes.d: It’s 1938, and hotheaded Londoner Joseph and his grandmother, Erina, have arrived in New York, where he wastes no time brandishing his innate tendencies—especially when he learns of Speedwagon’s expedition.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Game Master
programmes.d: Bullets fly and Hamon reverberates as brassy Joseph battles the Hamon master-turned-vampire Straizo. Later, an ominous revelation pulls Joseph to Mexico.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Pillar Man
programmes.d: In search of the mysterious Pillar Man, Joseph arrives in Mexico to promising news but deadly resistance. Now the German army’s thirst for power may have awakened an unstoppable power—even for Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: JoJo vs. The Ultimate Lifeform
programmes.d: Trading blows with Santviento, Joseph employs his usual wit, but the jokes fall as flat as the Hamon. Stroheim surprises as he sheds light on the lethal Pillar Men, leaving Joseph hanging in more ways than one.
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero, and he has yet to do anything heroic.
An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z. Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.
A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrives on the shores of City J, intent on invading the land.
A new ethics teacher, Toga Yagari, arrives at Cross Academy.
Zero tried to sink his fangs into Yuki, but he was able to get hold of himself just before he succumbed to his urge.
Yuki makes a secret decision regarding Zero, who is now determined to fight his affliction until the very end. Yuki feels guilty for betraying Kaname and keeping a secret from him…
There is a rare commotion in the Moon Dormitory when the Night Class gets word that Takuma’s grandfather will be visiting.
Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn't work.
L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura.
The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light's too perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own.
L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation.
As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one.
With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.
Ibara is critically injured after getting caught in a blast caused by the 1st Division’s tank.
While heading to the hospital, Ibara and her team run into Cleanup Crew members Kanon and Shion Ozu, otherwise known as the Ozu Sisters.
Haruto informs the group that a massive and lethal Zone is approaching the Planet.
The Coppelion set their escape plan into motion by dividing into two teams, with the Diversion Team led by Ibara.
The Diversion Team find themselves in serious trouble when the 1st Division brings out their secret weapon, the Iron Spider.
Ibara and the Diversion Team are nervously waiting for the train to arrive when they are attacked yet again by the Ozu Sisters.

programmes.t: Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Beast
programmes.d: Jun Fudo is taken by a mysterious woman and finds herself being attacked by a werewolf-like creature. As she tries to save herself, she transforms into Devil Lady.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and James Braxton, Day 2
programmes.d: Experts Catherine Southon and James Braxton's antiques adventure takes them through Worcestershire, Warwickshire and the West Midlands. Can James make a profit to catch Catherine?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and James Braxton, Day 3
programmes.d: A few pounds separate rival antiquers Catherine Southon and James Braxton. Tactics come into play ahead of a South Yorkshire auction. But there's time to savor a local delicacy.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and James Braxton, Day 4
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and James Braxton's take their antiques hunt to Derbyshire and Leicestershire. How do Catherine's 18th-century caryatid carvings measure up against James's very old bowl full of marbles?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and James Braxton, Day 5
programmes.d: With just six pounds separating them, Catherine Southon and James Braxton battle it out on the final leg of their adventure. Will a jug in the shape of an owl or a biscuit tin in the form of a travelling trunk make the biggest profit?

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer, Day 1
programmes.d: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer start their hunt in the bucolic Cotswolds. Charlie picks up a military first aid kit for a quite intimate area. And Izzie's eclectic mix of buys include a toast rack and a tutti-frutti bowl.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programmes.d: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer continue their trip in Surrey. Izzie finds a piece of jewelry that causes a stir at auction. And Charlie's passion for furniture uncovers a very rare table that sparks a frenzy of bids at the Dorking auction.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: In North Wessex Downs, Charlie Ross hunts for 'sparkly' antiques but is distracted by an Edwardian box that holds a surprise. And Izzie Balmer rummages in a shop's storeroom -- what goodies will she uncover?

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programmes.d: A rare antique gets Charlie Ross quite excited while Izzie Balmer gambles on some furniture. Their classic car is pointed to the south coast for auction but who'll claim victory?

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer, Day 5
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and Charlie Ross sail to the Isle of Wight for their final leg. Our experts go into auction battle one last time, when Izzie's silver brooch goes against Charlie's silver pen.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 1
programmes.d: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore travel from the Borders to the Lake District. They encounter the story of the country's greatest archers and visit a part of Scotland that's slowly revealing its secrets to archaeologists.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 2
programmes.d: Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth are shopping their way along the byways of Scotland. Angus bags something aromatic and coffee related, while Steven springs for a little treasure from his fellow expert's back yard in Yorkshire.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 3
programmes.d: While Angus Ashworth strips off for an unlikely history lesson, Steven Moore tucks into a local delicacy. Will a rough ferry crossing leave them feeling sick at the Clitheroe auction?

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 4
programmes.d: Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth hit the byways of Derbyshire and Yorkshire. They visit a couple of survivors from the Industrial Revolution and enjoy some regional pastries before heading off to an auction in the town of Bedale.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 5
programmes.d: Experts Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth browse the emporiums of northeast England, parting with their big budget. But who will be victorious at the deciding auction in Dundee?

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 1
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper sightsee around Northern Ireland in an old VW Beetle, on the lookout for an antique bargain. David visits the oldest distillery in the world, and Louise heads to the coast to sample some seaweed.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 2
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper continue their adventures in Northern Ireland. David gets a shock when he gets his hands on a Victorian cure-all, while Louise finds an ally while shopping.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 3
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper hit the shops in the northwest of England in their classic VW Beetle, keeping an eye out for items of interest, including some KGB spy equipment.
On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programmes.t: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programmes.d: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programmes.t: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programmes.d: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.
With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.
Entertainment is provided by The Spinners and the Jimmy Castor Bunch.
Stokely Carmichael, the revolutionary leader who created and promulgated the now historic cry of "Black Power", talks of his current plans that will bring Blacks together on this episode of Soul!
George and Katherine buy a hot tub that leaks so badly that it destroys the second floor bathroom.
George investigates why he was suddenly dropped as an endorsed candidate for the Board of Education.
Webster fantasizes that he is a hero in the Wild West defeating a bully.
At an art gallery, George glimpses at a truly shocking work of art: a nude portrait of Katherine in her younger days.
Webster and his classmates face some unfair competition when they're contestants on a TV quiz show.
Tia gets cold feet after agreeing to take an exam for her twin sister.
It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

programmes.st: Two Guys, A Girl, and a Calendar
programmes.d: Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.
A school fundraiser has boys putting together “date baskets” on which the girls bid.
Mo, Kim, and Hakeem are tense and stressed out studying for the SAT’s.
Hakeem’s cousin transfers to their school and Moesha goes out with him.

programmes.st: Women Are From Mars, Men Are From Saturn
programmes.d: Moesha is off visiting cousins out of town.  Meanwhile, Dee thinks Frank is spending too much time with “the boys” including his brother Bernie.
Frank’s nephew (Mo’s cousin) is the family’s “bad seed” and no one likes him around.
Suffering from a very cold winter spell, the residents of '227' invade Mary and Lester's apartment, which is one of two apartments with heat.
When Mary and Lester's school teacher friend Mitchell meets Sandra, he sets out to win her pampered heart, no matter how many gifts or expensive dates it takes.
After a whirlwind courtship, Sandra accepts Mitchell's wedding proposal, making a commitment to trade in her glamorous life for what she not-so-long-ago considered a boring existence.
When Pearl finds out that Calvin is failing his history class, Mary, Rose and Lester each take turns as tutor-in-residence.
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.
Nicolette enlists Malcolm and Eddie to convince her boyfriend to propose.
A friend's upcoming wedding cause Malcolm and Eddie to reexamine their feelings about the women in their own lives.
A surprise birthday party for Malcolm's dad sets the Shermans and McGees to fighting.

programmes.st: The Slender Arm Of The Law
programmes.d: Eddie tries to help out the retired race car driver who helped get his first job.

Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.
The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!
When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!
Karrin joins the Brittons' fancy Fourth of July party, Carolyn takes drastic action when Morgan gives Malcolm an ultimatum, and Anthony's evening with Vanessa takes a dark turn.
Peter's jealousy deepens as Tania and Jesse grow closer, Martin makes a difficult choice, and Carolyn gloats over her victory -- but Anthony has one more trick up his sleeve.
A bidding war ensues at the annual charity art auction, Anthony and Vanessa keep their business relationship close to the vest, and Carolyn and Christopher mix business with pleasure.
Cassie rejoins the dating world, setting her on a collision course with Cam. And his checkbook. Reggie meets the strange and brilliant man who made Flaherty all his money.
Cam's first game back in Boston is getting to him. And to Reggie, who has to deal with Cam's old obligations. The family tours a plantation and delves into racial tensions.
Reggie meets Jupiter Blackmon, a prospect headed for NFL superstardom. Reggie looks to rep Jupiter, expanding Cam's empire. M-Chuck helps a young pregnant girl.
Chen throws a gala to launch Cam's endorsed shoe but his real focus is wooing Cassie. Cam recklessly makes a romantic connection with a sideline reporter and it goes awry.
Facing a potential career-ending injury, Cam meets a girl who could be the one. Reggie's repping of Jupiter along with Cam starts to seem like a fool's errand.
Smitten with Allison, Cam puts on a full-court press on their first date. Uncle Julius takes a disturbing jaunt with the Atlanta police and M-Chuck undergoes court-ordered therapy.
Jupiter's draft status hangs in the balance so Missy tutors him, which proves to be a challenge. Cam and Allison's romance expands, as do Reggie's business prospects.
Reggie questions representing Jupiter, but Cam has no doubt about Allison. He is in love…even more so after Allison declines his expensive gifts. The family experiences a crisis.
Derwin gets jealous when Janay's ex-boyfriend comes into town; Melanie turns to the cable guy for comfort after the loss of her relationship with Derwin.

Malik meets his half-sister and worries that he may have slept with her before they knew they were related; Tasha meets her former husband's wife and is shocked to see that the woman is surprisingly similar to herself.
Kelly is forced to come to terms with Jason's new girlfriend Camille. Meanwhile, Tasha and Kelly are planning an engagement party for Mel and Derwin.
While shopping with Tasha, Mel finds her perfect wedding dress. Meanwhile, Jason's relationship evolves to the next level, and he wants Camille to meet his daughter.

programmes.st: I Want It All And I Want It Now
programmes.d: Melanie decides she wants to get married to Derwin before Janay's baby is born; Kelly and Jason share an emotional moment; Tasha finally admits to setting Jason up with Camille.
The third season concludes with Melanie trying to marry Derwin before Janay gives birth to Derwin's baby, even if it requires sacrificing her dream wedding.
Melanie and Derwin expereience trouble in paradise when Melanie takes it upon herself to swab DJ, only to find out the baby isn't Derwin's.
Melanie deals with the backlash of having told Derwin the results of the DNA test, only to learn that the results are incorrect.
Kara's life continues to spin out of control. Meanwhile, a bored and still grieving Mary Jane helps Niecy land her first job.
When SNC decides to keep Marisol in the prime-time seat, Mary Jane explores unconventional methods to fight for her future.
Mark is publicly outed, and while he is horrified, SNC is thrilled and wants to capitalize on his new gay icon status. A scary encounter with Cutty Buddy forces MJ to reconsider their future.
When Helen takes ill, MJ's birthday takes a back seat to family drama. Patrick experiments with a performance-enhancing drug with his coworkers.
When Mary Jane sits in on a journalism lecture and hears harsh opinions of her show. Patrick's life seems to be on track until he's surprised with a family intervention about his drug use.

Gerald Davenport has requested his three estranged daughters Diedre, Nicole, and Tammy come together for Christmas for a big announcement…he has won a $10-million-dollar lottery! To get their share, the sisters must repair their broken relationship.
After an on-and-off relationship, Noelle and Terrance reunite during the holidays, but Noelle is surprised when Terrance returns home with a new girlfriend of the same name.
BET+ ORIGINAL. In this Christmas musical, songbird Montana helps to enlighten others about loss and love when she accepts a job as a nanny to a grieving billionaire two kids.
A couple share their Christmas Love Story with a friend to encourage that love and miracles still happen around Christmas.
A woman with a downtrodden life who hates Christmas, longs for the life she could have had as a singer. She meets an angel who grants her wish.

Holiday, a female impersonator, bonds with a child and her drug-addicted mother and helps them off the street. But when the mom hooks up with a drug dealer, it forces Holiday to confront his own prejudices if it means saving the two people he loves.

After burying their father earlier in the year, Baneatta and Beverly attempt to carry on his Christmas traditions without strangling each other - but when an unknown half-sister arrives, more than just Christmas presents are opened.
The holidays take a wrong turn when identical twin sisters agree to switch places for one night only at their parents' Christmas party.
Two colleagues fighting for a promotion get stuck in an elevator together on Christmas Eve.
Mark accepts Trey's (REGGIE McFADDEN) offer to be his roommate in an apartment building filled with beautiful women and wild parties.
When Mark's grandmother (MONTROSE HAGINS) visits him, he wants to impress her with his success and asks Robin and Vanessa to pose as his servants.
Mark's cousin, Geneva (SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN), and her daughter, Nicole (RAVEN-SYMONÉ), move into Mark and Vanessa's house.
When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.
When Moesha borrows money from Frank to buy a mother’s day present for Dee, but only gives Dee socks, Frank is upset.

Danny and Jackie investigate the suspicious death of a high-rolling investor who sustained injuries in a fight, yet his hands are unmarked by trauma.

Danny and Jackie set out to investigate the murder of a bride on her wedding day in a drive-by gang shooting.

The Cartwrights' friendship with a neighboring rancher is threatened by his mentally unstable daughter.
While Sheriff Coffee is in Saint Louis, the Morrisey bunch decides to work off excess energy by wrecking the saloon in a violent spree.
A stranger, Bob Jolly, arrives in Virginia City to accuse a drunken Judge Harry Whitaker of sending his innocent father, Carl, to the gallows.

Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.
An Indian-hating officer, Colonel Edward J. Dunwoody, comes to the Ponderosa looking for army deserter Bill Winters, who is a good friend of the Cartwrights.

Laura Dayton's Aunt Lil comes to visit and quickly decides it's time she helps the hesitant Adam propose to her favorite niece.  Her plan is to make Adam jealous by using his cousin Will but it doesn't go exactly as planned.
Warbling Andy Walker returns to Virginia City a big success, along with his shifty Uncle Thaddeus.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.

programmes.d: Women from the Pacific Northwest begin to disappear without a trace.
Ted Bundy escapes not once, but twice, from authorities.

A body is discovered stuffed into a working chimney of a residential home.
A crime documentary series follows the CSIs for the first 48 hours of an investigation.
A high profile murder trial is thrown into a tailspin when two siblings confess to the same crime.
Science collides with the occult when the team investigates the case of a psychic who predicted her own murder.
The CSIs enter the world of rap music in order to investigate the deaths of three teenagers killed while working for rival rappers.
Solving the case of a wealthy defense attorney killed at her son's wedding is compromised when all of the evidence is stolen along with Nick's car.
The evidence in the case of a high-stakes gambler and ladies man murdered outside a casino after a night of revelry proves that appearances can be deceiving.
A man accused of murdering his wife and co-workers leads the CSIs on a wild chase through a busy Vegas casino.
The CSI team rallies around one of their own, who is shot in the line of duty and may not survive on the sixth season finale.
Gil Grissom is the supervisor of the graveyard shift of Las Vegas' elite crime scene investigators. Holly Gribbs, fresh out of the academy, joins the team.
A man is killed after winning a fortune and then dumping his girlfriend. So, Grissom, Nick, and newcomer to the CSI team, Sara Sidle, investigate this one.
Grissom, Nick, and Sara search for a kidnapped woman and find more than they expected. Catherine and Warrick investigate the hit-and-run death of a little girl.
Grissom and Catherine investigate when a leg is found severed from a body in a lake. Meanwhile, Sara and Nick investigate a fraternity pledging gone terribly wrong.
Grissom and Warrick take the case of a young man who is found naked in the desert without an obvious cause of death.

Catherine violates department protocol when she takes the case of a rape accusation against her ex-husband. Warrick and Sara search for the missing bullet that will either exonerate or indict a cop for murder.
When a teenager and her sister are the sole survivors of the gruesome murder of four members of one family in a quiet suburban neighborhood, Grissom and his entire team investigate the crime.
Horatio Caine and the CSI team solve the murder of a man who was killed in outer space before returning his body to beautiful Miami.
Horatio Caine and Delko must travel to bright and sunny Los Angeles when a secret from Jesse's past may allow a killer to go free.
Horatio Caine and the CSI team unravel a complicated workplace murder mystery when a hated receptionist is found murdered in beautiful Miami.
When Horatio Caine's son Kyle returns from the war, he seeks the help of his father and the CSI team to solve a disturbing murder.
Spring Break raises the body count in Miami when Horatio Caine and the CSI team splits up to solve three different murders.
A victim's spirit won't leave Calleigh alone until she finds justice for his murder. She must enlist the help of Horatio and the rest of the CSI team.
A seemingly perfect jewelry heist ends in murder and when crime scene evidence is stolen from the lab, and Delko returns to find the culprit.
When a suburban soccer mom is murdered, the CSIs uncover her family's dark past, while Delko continues his undercover mission.
When Horatio Caine's ex-girlfriend is killed in an explosion, the team looks within their own department to find the killer.
A serial killer taunts the CSIs by leaving them cryptic hints, and the longer it takes them to decode these puzzles, the higher the death toll rises.
The CSI team investigates the murder of a probation officer, and Horatio learns that one of the suspects in the murder may be a son he didn’t know he had.
The CSI team investigates the apparent murder of a college girl, while Delko has mysterious sightings of the late Tim Speedle.
After the Internet turns a high school girl into an international sex symbol, information leaked about Horatio puts his life in danger.
Horatio and the CSI team exhaustively search for Horatio’s son after he goes missing during a surprising and deadly prison break.
When a sports legend is murdered, the investigation hits a snag when the lab loses the body.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Bizarre occurrences begin to plague the CSIs as they hunt down a serial killer who struck during a total eclipse of the sun.
When a model is electrocuted on the runway, the case leads Horatio and the CSI team back to Horatio’s son and his nemesis.
The CSIs appear to have an open and shut case after a murder suspect is impaled during a police pursuit, but it turns out to only be beginning.
Young brides-to-be fight over a killer dress at the biggest wedding gown sale of the year and one of the shoppers winds up dead.
The CSIs must piece together a human jigsaw puzzle when a beloved wrestling coach's severed body parts are found buried throughout the city.
A Russian tourist is found stabbed to death and the CSIs come face to face with the frightening realities of human trafficking.
When the Mayor's dead body falls from the ceiling at a charity fundraiser, Stella and her date find themselves in the middle of the crime scene.
When a buzzard flying over Manhattan drops a human eyeball from its claw, the race is on to find the body it belongs to.
A lethal pipe bomb blows a Manhattan townhouse and valuable evidence to pieces, forcing the CSIs to get creative in reconstructing evidence.
A former medical examiner is found murdered, a white powder found at the scene provides the CSIs with a major lead in tracking the killer.
When a Native American chief is shot, the CSIs struggle to translate which one of the several foreign suspects may have caused his death.
While investigating the shooting of a man in an empty theater, Stella realizes that the crime scene is oddly familiar and staged.
When a man falls 52 stories to his death, and his body goes missing after it hits the ground, the CSIs must treat this as a missing persons case.
The most exclusive jewelry auction of the year ends abruptly when an appraiser is killed during the event. The investigation takes an emotional turn.
Mac informs an ex-con that he served time for a crime he didn't commit, and Anna tells Danny it's time for the first CSI baby to be born.
Stella discovers that New Yorkers are being murdered over ancient Greek artifacts, she hands over her badge to follow a clue that leads to Greece.
When transferring Robert Dunbrook's son from prison to court, the NYPD is ambushed by a group of professional kidnappers.
One CSI New York team member's life is changed forever in a significant way following the aftermath of a shooting incident.
The CSI New York team is tracking a cyber-killer who is currently threatening the lives of several medical healthcare workers.
Tatum Paxley defends the NXT Women's North American Title against Zaria. Tristan Angels and Shiloh Hill aim to become Mr. NXT.
Tony D'Angelo and Naraku come face to face before their epic battle at NXT Great American Bash. A new Women's Speed Tournament begins.
Two major contract signings set the stage for The Great American Bash. Aaron Rourke defends the Evolve Championship against Tristan Angels.
NXT and AAA clash in an epic inter-promotional title fight with AAA's Galeno and El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. challenging NXT's Vanity Project.
An opportunity to become the No. 1 Contender to the NXT Women's Championship awaits as 20 Superstars collide in a Battle Royal.
Tony D'Angelo and Myles Borne clash for the right to challenge NXT Champion Grayson Waller at Halloween Havoc. The Dusty Classic Quarterfinals begin.
Cruz Montana seeks payback against Dion Lennox following a backstage beatdown. The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Quarterfinals continue.
WWE Superstars compete to prove they've got what it takes.
On the road to NXT Halloween Havoc 2026, Sam Roberts and Megan Morant preview the clashes headlining the spookiest night of the year.
Title fights headline NXT's Halloween showcase, with Grayson Waller facing Tony D'Angelo in a rematch and Kelani Jordan opposing Wren Sinclair.
Zaria awaits the next challenger to the NXT Women's North American Title after Layla Diggs' injury creates an unexpected opportunity.

Unbeknownst to the sisters, baby Wyatt's new 'imaginary' friend is actually a demon named Vicus who is trying to win Wyatt's trust to turn him evil. Meanwhile, Piper casts a spell to be able to understand baby Wyatt.
When a person who was killed right in front of Phoebe comes back from the dead to blame her, she becomes guilt-ridden and vulnerable, creating an opportunity for Zankou to steal the Book of Shadows.

When the sisters try to divert Zankou's attention from the Nexus, he hatches a plan to absorb all their powers. However, when the girls realize what Zankou is up to, they are faced with a life-altering decision: sacrifice their powers or their lives.
After being presumed dead, the Halliwell sisters begin their demon-free existence with new identities.
While attempting to take over the Underworld, a young demon plots to lure the Charmed Ones out of hiding, but when Billie stumbles onto his plot ,she becomes one of his victims instead.
When Piper goes for a job interview with a corporate recruiter, she's shocked to learn that the background check of her assumed identity was that of a woman wanted for murder.

Wyatt's school play brings out the competitive nature in Piper when her hand-sewn costume & parenting abilities are criticized by another mother. However things go from bad to worse, because this Stepford-like mother is actually a demon in disguise.

Billie jeopardizes the Charmed Ones' new lives when Agent Murphy spots her using her powers to save an innocent. Meanwhile, Phoebe's overnight trip with Dex comes to a surprising conclusion when Billie casts a spell to make her happy.

Billie must deal with her painful childhood memories of her sister's kidnapping, before she can vanquish her latest demon target, The Dogan. Meanwhile, the press are bombarding the sisters, since the announcement of their teaming with Homeland Security.
Wanting to return to her old career as a social worker, Paige's plans get put on hold, when her Whitelighter father, Sam, returns asking for her help with his charge.
Agent Murphy gives the sisters their first Homeland Security case - searching through cold case files, where Phoebe and Billie discover a belt that gives Billie superpowers.
When a demon escapes from custody, Agent Murphy enlists the Charmed Ones to help, where they learn a government created virus is spreading amongst magical beings, that causes them to 'hulk out'.

The Angel of Death returns to visit the Charmed Ones but they're shocked to learn that he's there for Leo. To try to stop him from taking Leo, Piper casts a spell that backfires, making every man a Leo lookalike.

When her parents come for a visit, Billie accidently transforms them into assassins and also manages to contact a demon who is posing as a human. Meanwhile, Piper attempts to continue her life without Leo.
With the intention of helping his parolee get a loan, Henry, along with Paige, go to a bank but instead the parolee decides to take everyone at the bank hostage.

Phoebe, in an attempt to move on with her own life, signs a lease for a new apartment, and Paige considers moving in with Henry. However the sisters are forced to remain under the same roof when a demon shrinks them.

During Chinese New Year, a demon attempts to steal a mystical wooden staff, that's protected by the Zodiacs and they enlist the aid of Piper. Meanwhile, Phoebe enjoys her new place by throwing a housewarming party that gets out of control.

Despite Rebecca's rich taste in men, she falls for a local plumber.

Diane suggests Carla consult a psychologist to learn to control her temper.
Sam's sportscaster friend wants to feature him on his television show.
Coach discourages his daughter from marrying her pompous and rude fiancé.
